Title: Why You Keep Waking Up at Night to Pee (3 Evening Habits)

Description:
Most men in their 50s and 60s already get up at night to pee, and most just blame it on getting older. An enlarged prostate is part of it, but caffeine, alcohol, and a salty dinner can all make it worse by increasing how much urine you make or irritating the bladder.

Watch to see why each one happens, and the simple timing fix for each.

Most men in their 50s and 60s already get up at night to pee 🚽

Caffeine and alcohol both block the hormone that helps your kidneys hold onto water, and a salty dinner makes you thirstier right before bed. None of it means something's wrong - just watching timing and amount in the evening helps.
